findings.title: Path-based English file derivation breaks and can silently skip or misreport
findings.body: The English counterpart is computed by regex-replacing `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` on the absolute path. Any directory component containing an underscore or the substring 'resources-community' (e.g. user home paths) can be mangled, and files without a locale suffix (e.g. messages.properties) would be rewritten incorrectly. When the English file is missing, the verifier throws RuntimeException instead of a MojoExecutionException, aborting the whole build with an unhelpful stack trace. Derivation should use the file name and parent directory explicitly.

findings.title: Bundle re-read from disk instead of using already-read contents; checked I/O converted to RuntimeException
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() re-opens the file via FileInputStream even though verify() already read the contents. The IOException is wrapped in a RuntimeException rather than the declared MojoExecutionException, so plugin failures surface as uncaught runtime exceptions instead of a proper Maven build error.

findings.title: Policy field declared as package-private instance fields, and sanitizer quirks are only partially handled
findings.body: POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS are non-final, non-private instance fields recreated per object. The sanitizer's known behavior of escaping numeric tags like <1> and braces is patched with ad-hoc string replacements (unescapeHtml4, replace "<!-- -->"), so legitimate ICU placeholders in translations can produce false positives or mask real problems. These should be static final and the normalization should be documented/tested.

findings.title: Anchor replacement uses replaceFirst on the whole value, removing wrong occurrences
findings.body: santizeAnchors removes the matched English anchor string from the translated value with replaceFirst, which can remove an anchor that is not the one just matched, and the loop continues scanning the original matcher over the unmodified value. Combined with the early break, mismatched or extra anchors can be silently accepted or reported with misleading positions.

findings.title: Anchor check messages are added but validation continues; keys with missing English value are silently treated as English=empty
findings.body: getEnglishValue returns "" for a missing key, so any translated key that has no English counterpart is checked against an empty English string. That means HTML in such keys is flagged as illegal and anchors are flagged as not found, yet orphan keys are never reported as a problem themselves. The behavior is undocumented and produces confusing errors.

findings.title: Unrelated translation change to Swedish file (removing link text) is out of scope and loses content
findings.body: The diff replaces the FreeOTP/Google Authenticator link text with a generic sentence in a community translation, dropping the apps list without any corresponding English source change. Similar unrelated content removal occurs in the fi, lt, sk, zh_CN account and login bundles, so translators' links to app stores are lost.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_lt.properties now reads 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian. The Lithuanian user sees untranslated Italian text. The same erroneous Italian string is introduced into login/messages_lt.properties (loginTotpStep1) and must be reverted or properly translated.

findings.title: Italian string introduced into Lithuanian login messages
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 is changed to the Italian sentence 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', replacing the Lithuanian text. Lithuanian users will see Italian in the TOTP setup page.

findings.title: Malformed href attribute introduced in HTML email templates
findings.body: The diff rewrites `href=LT"{0}"` into `href="{0}"` correctly, but the surrounding original text remains with typos and the verification fixes are mixed into unrelated edits; more importantly, the link fix changes rendered output in emails that users relied on, without a corresponding change to tests. Also the email-body pattern `{0}` is used for link in identityProviderLinkBodyHtml where `{3}` is the link; the same message in messages_lt uses {3} for link and {0} for another value, showing the translated HTML link target changed meaning.

findings.title: Placeholder {2} choice corrupted to reference {1} in multivalued-size message
findings.body: The fix changes the trailing choice to `{2,choice,...}` for the max count, but the original text had `{1,choice,...}` for max, which the diff edits in the last line. Other locales (cs) use {1} for the min count choice and {2} for max, so the Slovak message is now consistent; however the change removes the trailing newline ('\ No newline at end of file'), which is a minor formatting regression.

findings.body:
The change from `

findings.title: Stray `< p>` tag repaired but unescaped Persian HTML elsewhere remains invalid
findings.body:
The fix corrects `< p>` to `

` in emailUpdateConfirmationBodyHtml. Other similar malformed tags in the same and other translation files (e.g. `` in tr, `` in nl) are only partially fixed, so the sanitizer will still flag or mis-render them; the fix set is inconsistent.

findings.title: Norwegian identityProviderLinkBody now shows raw HTML in plain-text email
findings.body: The plain-text identityProviderLinkBody change replaces `{1}` with `{1}`, which is the correct fix for plain text, but the change is unrelated to the sanitizer described in the PR and silently alters the wording of the text body (removing the emphasis markers) without a corresponding test.

findings.title: Slovak impersonateTitleHtml fix drops a stray closing tag, but nearby keys still malformed
findings.body: The change removes a dangling `` from impersonateTitleHtml. This is a valid fix but the same PR leaves other messages with mismatched tags in the same file, so the verification gate is not comprehensive.

findings.title: Tests do not assert that clean files produce no messages
findings.body: The new tests only check that specific messages appear (hasItem). There is no negative test that a valid translation (e.g. noHtml_en or a valid anchor case) yields an empty list, so false positives from the sanitizer would go undetected. The existing duplicate-keys test was also weakened from contains to hasItem, reducing its precision.

findings.title: Fixture noHtml_de is paired with an English file that does not exist in the test resources
findings.body: The verifier derives the English file by replacing the locale suffix with _en in the same directory. For noHtml_de.properties the expected English file is noHtml_en.properties, which exists, but the path rewrite (resources-community to resources) is never exercised by tests, so the derivation logic is untested.

findings.title: New sanitizer and commons-text dependencies added to a Maven plugin without shading or version alignment
findings.body: owasp-java-html-sanitizer and commons-text are added as compile-scope dependencies of a maven-plugin artifact. They are transitively resolved into every consumer's build classpath and may conflict with the versions Maven itself or other plugins use (commons-lang/commons-text). The new dependency surface is not justified in the description.

findings.title: Choice format in admin message no longer matches the rest of the key set
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size now uses a ChoiceFormat for the {2} placeholder while {1} is used as a plain number, and the English message in the account UI keeps the same key with a different shape; the message has different placeholder conventions across bundles (some use {0}, others {{0}}), making the translations inconsistent.
